ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
